text:
sam_ae: Quick sync — Quantico Health wants a short trial to validate claims classification + redact PHI before storage. They asked for clear success criteria and a 6-week timeline. Who can own endpoint mapping?
priya_se: I can lead endpoint mapping. Proposed MVP endpoints: /classify-claim, /redact-payload, /explain-decision (lightweight). Prioritize classify + redact for first 2 weeks.
morgan_eng: For latency/throughput targets we should aim for 95th < 300ms on dedicated instance with quantized model. Need their expected qps. Also recommend prefix KV caching for repeated patient patterns.
javier_infosec: Security checklist: PHI in transit and at rest, SOC2 questions, KMS integration, and data residency in us-east-1. Will need their DPO to sign an addendum for tokenized logs.
emma_csm: I've requested their QPS & sample payloads — awaiting. Also flagged the standard security questionnaire; Quantico expects answers this week.
priya_se: For evals: we'll provide a small prompt set (20 examples) + metrics: precision/recall on entity redaction, false positive rate on classification, and a prompt-sensitivity check. Which team runs the eval harness?
morgan_eng: Eng-ml can run the harness. I'll spin up a sandbox route: quantico-trial.sandbox.redwood with pinned model rwd-llm-v2-8q. Can we allow a temporary on-prem connector if they need PHI never leaving site?
sam_ae: That was a hard ask — enterprise buyer. Sales prefers cloud first, but roadmap: show cloud secure option + on-prem add-on pricing. Need rough pricing tiers for 10k, 50k, 250k tokens/day.
emma_csm: I'll draft pricing options. Also add a canary plan: start with hosted sandbox, then Dedicated pool, then Private.
javier_infosec: Also note: requirement for audit logs without raw PHI. We should propose tokenization + redaction in-flight. I'll add recommended language to the security answers.
priya_se: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) classification precision >= 92% on their eval set, 2) redaction misses <= 1%, 3) end-to-end flow latency 95th < 300ms, 4) deployment risk assessment completed. Agree?
 sam_ae: tiny typo in prior msg? But yes, those look good. Add rollback strategy: fallback route to a conservative rule-based classifier.
morgan_eng: Noted — I'll prepare the sandbox route + canary rollout plan and share infra runbook. Will include sample curl for endpoints:
```
curl -X POST https://quantico-trial.sandbox.redwood/v1/classify-claim \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
 -d '{"claim_text":"..."}'
```
emma_csm: Timeline checklist: Week 0: kick, access + questionnaire; Week 1-2: endpoint build + evals; Week 3: performance tuning; Week 4: security sign-off; Week 5-6: pilot & acceptance.
sam_ae: Blockers to resolve: signed DPA, their DPO availability, and final QPS numbers. I'll chase legal & quantico PM.
javier_infosec: Please send the security questionnaire answers to me before sending to customer. I'll review today.
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: #DL-4721 — sandbox route + canary policy.
emma_csm: Great work — I'll consolidate success criteria and send an internal one-pager for review before we share with Quantico.
sam_ae: Thanks team — flag any blockers inline. I'll set a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize the plan.
